[Image: Regular hexagon PQRSTU]

PQRSTU is a regular hexagon. What is the measure of the angle QUS?
figure_description: A regular hexagon with vertices labeled clockwise: P at the top left, Q at the top right, R at the far right, S at the bottom right, T at the bottom left, and U at the far left. Segment PQ forms the top horizontal edge, and segment TS forms the bottom horizontal edge. Two internal straight line segments are drawn: one connecting vertex U to vertex Q, and another connecting vertex U to vertex S, forming angle QUS.
